data.title: 陆八魔阿露 · 硬汉恶徒的彻底露馅
data.action: 靠在皮沙发扶手上，单手试图摆出冷酷无情的恶党黑手党大佬姿态，但一看到老师目光扫过胸口，立刻手忙脚乱涨红了脸。
data.location: 便利屋68事务所后室，红色天鹅绒沙发旁堆着未付的拉面账单与通缉令

data.lighting: 桌面复古绿罩台灯在酒红沙发上投下浓郁复古的光晕，衬托出阿露丰满艳丽的身段
data.mood: 装腔作势的大佬气场与瞬间破功的少女娇羞，极度搞笑可爱
data.description: 便利屋68事务所后室，红色天鹅绒沙发旁堆着未付的拉面账单与通缉令。靠在皮沙发扶手上，单手试图摆出冷酷无情的恶党黑手党大佬姿态，但一看到老师目光扫过胸口，立刻手忙脚乱涨红了脸。 她微微抬眸轻语——“咳！听好了老师，本事务所的硬汉恶徒可不会因为这点装束动摇……呀！不许直勾勾看那里啦呜呜！”
data.promptProse: Seated on the red velvet sofa in the dim back room of Problem Solver 68 beside stacks of unpaid ramen bills and wanted posters, Aru wears a magenta-and-black lace ruffle-trimmed bustier lingerie set with velvet trim. Leaning one elbow on the armrest to strike a cool outlaw pose, her bravado instantly crumbles into a panicked blush and nervous sweat as she catches the viewer's gaze. A green-shaded vintage desk lamp casts warm retro light across her flushed cheeks and plush couch.
data.animaCaption: Sitting stiffly on the red velvet office sofa in her magenta-and-black lace bustier lingerie, Aru tries to hold a suave outlaw pose while breaking into a panicked blush and sweat beside unpaid bills. Warm green-shaded desk lamplight glows over the dark back room.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a magenta-and-black lace ruffle-trimmed push-up bustier lingerie set with velvet accents and a deep sweetheart neckline.
